entries.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes that a framework-native backend can retain exact support decisions, explicit failure behavior, tensor-state continuity, and accelerator-artifact identity while execution no longer incurs one host-visible completion cycle per admitted unit — stakes: backend maintainers otherwise face either silent semantic drift and wrong outputs or a formally correct integration whose launch overhead blocks useful deployment and wastes FPGA development effort.
entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The recurring reject shape (drawn from a healthy 12-paper Reject sample) is assembling existing relational-learning components — message passing plus attention plus sequential state tracking, or a domain-derived graph plus a standard GNN — into a problem-specific architecture, then claiming the encoded relational structure as the contribution without proving it. The wrong assumption is that wiring domain or relational structure into a model is itself the advance: reviewers instead read incremental assembly whenever the genuinely novel piece versus the inherited components is not sharply delineated.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Combining borrowed modules (global plus local streams, attention plus state tracking) with no genuinely new mechanism reads as incremental even when the combination is sensible.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The candidate combines standard alias/effect analysis, subgraph fusion, strict delegation, and an existing residency mirror path, while the digest-bound success-only contract is sharply specified but may still be packaging rather than a new execution mechanism.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A domain-grounded architecture lacking any theoretical guarantee that its wiring captures the claimed structure — and lacking a uniqueness or identifiability argument — leaves reviewers unable to credit the structural claim.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The canonical F16 footprint construction and static checker provide a checkable certificate of byte disjointness and effect closure, with deterministic selection and live slot binding.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: This cluster's move is to make the relational connectivity topology itself the encoded structural prior: define which entities link to which (and under what relation type), then run message-passing/propagation over that wiring so a specific structural quantity is captured by construction rather than relearned by a generic dense or attention model. The load-bearing object is always the graph/relation wiring or a statistic over it, not a transformation-group symmetry.
